releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- cf4c7c3: Add one-word tags to options, such as Recommended or Current, shown next to the option's title and included in the answers.

### Patch Changes

- 9c42b76: Scale tall mockups and images down so both options of a pair fit on screen together.

### Patch Changes

- 612d1e4: Show images at their own size, or the width and height the deck gives, instead of stretching them to the card's width.

### Minor Changes

- 6236836: Add opencode-settle: agents hand you open decisions as a deck you settle two options at a time in a panel beside the session.

### Patch Changes

- 8cb1f11: Add Discard (D) to drop a decision without answering it, and move the progress bar with every pick.
